title: Guardrails (1): buckets, automation, allocation, rebalancing
objectives: Set up goal buckets, automated SIPs, a written allocation and a rebalancing rule.
Say which bias each guardrail counters.
body_md:
Biases are beaten by decisions made in calm times and written down, not by willpower in a crisis. Goal-based buckets: each goal has its own amount, date and asset mix — counters mental accounting and short-term framing. Automated SIPs and step-ups: investing happens without a decision each month — counters inertia and market timing. Written target allocation: for example 60% equity / 40% debt, agreed and signed — counters herd behaviour and recency. Rebalancing rule: rebalance when allocation drifts beyond an agreed band, for example ±5% — counters loss aversion and euphoria.

| Guardrail | How it works | Bias it counters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Goal-based buckets | Each goal has its own amount, date and asset mix | Mental accounting, short-term framing |
| Automated SIPs and step-ups | Investing happens without a decision each month | Inertia, market timing |
| Written target allocation | e.g. 60% equity / 40% debt, agreed and signed | Herd behaviour, recency |
| Rebalancing rule | Rebalance when allocation drifts beyond an agreed band, e.g. ±5% | Loss aversion, euphoria |

> **Talk-track:** “Let's write down your plan now, while markets are calm, so we can follow it when they're not.”
example: 60/40 agreed and signed: when equity runs to 70%, the rule sells some gains and buys debt — the opposite of what emotions suggest.
say: Decide rules in calm times; follow them in volatile times.
A written allocation counters herd behaviour and recency.
never: Rely on willpower in a crisis.
Rebalance only when you feel like it.

check.q: What does the cooling-off rule say?
o: No switch or redemption on the same day as a big market move
check.why: No switch or redemption on the same day as a big market move. It stops panic or FOMO decisions in the heat of the moment.

check.q: Which guardrail counters inertia and market timing?
check.why: Automated SIPs and step-ups: investing happens without a decision each month. Counters inertia, market timing.
Rebalancing rule: counters loss aversion, euphoria.
